weapon.correct_value: No weapon identified; death caused by strangulation

weapon.reason: Judgment states the cause of death was strangulation, not that no weapon existed; 'None mentioned' is inaccurate.

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial evidence: child witness testimony, s.27 recoveries, fingerprint report, FSL report, motive of robbery, last seen together
evidence_type.quote: (i) Testimony of child witness... (ii) The recoveries made under Section 27... (v) Motive... (vi) Evidence of last seen together
evidence_type.reason: Omits motive and last-seen evidence, which the prosecution relied on as circumstances.

confession.reason: No confession is described; s.27 memorandum statements are not treated as confessions.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are discussed; 'None noted' is consistent with the text.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are discussed in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced with capital punishment for the offence under Section 302
trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions Court convicted and sentenced both accused to death.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Affirmed death sentence; dismissed appeals and confirmed the Sessions Court judgment
high_court_outcome.quote: High Court by its judgment dated 30.04.2015 affirmed the judgment of the Sessions Court
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court affirmed the death sentence and dismissed the appeals; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

offence_finally_established.quote: The appellants/accused are hereby acquitted for the offences for which they were tried
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established against the accused.

imprisonment_type.reason: Final order sets aside all sentences, so no imprisonment remains.

imprisonment_years.reason: No final imprisonment term; trial-level ten-year term was set aside.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine; the trial-level Rs.500 fine was set aside with the conviction.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Two male accused; five women found dead in the house after 16-17.12.2012; circumstantial case with child witness, recoveries, fingerprint and FSL reports; trial court sentenced both to death; High Court affirmed.
neutral_facts.quote: The appeals succeed and are allowed
neutral_facts.reason: Neutral facts reveal the Supreme Court outcome, and describe a single victim rather than five deceased women.

offence_severity.reason: Severity is not formally stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Judgment does not classify attempt or completion; deaths occurred.

number_of_offences.quote: murder of all the five ladies
number_of_offences.reason: Five deaths are correct, but the counts were not 'upheld' since the Supreme Court acquitted.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Robbery alleged; cash of Rs.3000 and Rs.2600 and silver anklet seized, but loss not established

witness_credibility.quote: Her evidence is fraught with inconsistencies
